summary: Verified Top Performers (pe-top) grid layout on Admin > Platform Earning. Desktop 1920 → 3 columns (row1: service_revenue, service_profit, category_revenue; row2: category_profit, city_revenue, partner; row3: merchant). Tablet 768 → 2 columns. Mobile 390 → 1 column. No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth at all breakpoints). Click drill-down works: clicking Top Revenue Service card applied a 'Service: AC Service (Split)' filter chip and showed toast 'Filtered by service: AC Service (Split)'.
test_credentials: Login as Admin button + OTP 123456 at /api/panel/login
context_for_next_testing_agent: PeAnalytics.jsx TopPerformers uses `grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3` at line 116. Build already contains fix. Verified via live measurements at 1920/768/390 viewports.
rca of the issue: Previously 7 cards likely rendered in a single horizontal scroll row causing the last card to clip. Switching to responsive CSS grid (1/2/3 cols) resolves overflow across viewports.
